description: This Java class defines a set of constants used across multiple classes in the Android thread sample project. It includes configuration flags, intent action strings, fragment tags, extra keys for intents, a user-agent string, various status codes, and a blank character sequence.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A utility class containing static final constants used throughout the app for intents, logging, status, and configuration.
